question: Does the Starter plan support CSV export?
expected_answer: Yes, Starter supports CSV export through the web UI, not through the API. CSV launched March 12, 2025.

question: Can a Viewer on Business export XLSX?
expected_answer: No. Business includes XLSX web UI export, but the Viewer role cannot export on any plan.

question: Why does POST /exports return 403 for Starter?
expected_answer: API exports require Pro or Business. Starter API access does not include export jobs, although Starter has CSV web UI export.

question: When did TaskFlow add JSON export, and which plans have it?
expected_answer: JSON export was added April 9, 2026 for Pro and Business via web UI and API.

question: Is Business XLSX export available through the API?
expected_answer: No. XLSX is exclusive to the Business web UI; API exports support CSV or JSON for Pro and Business.

question: How many API requests per minute can Starter make?
expected_answer: 60 requests per minute per workspace, shared across all tokens.

question: Can I get a refund on my first annual subscription after 10 days?
expected_answer: Yes. A first-time annual subscription can be refunded in full within 14 calendar days of the initial charge.

question: What happens after repeated payment failures?
expected_answer: Payments are retried on days 1, 3, 7, and read-only grace mode starts on day 8 if unsuccessful.

question: Can a Member see any private project?
expected_answer: No. Members need an explicit private-project invitation; workspace Owners can access all projects.

question: Does the Free plan include API access?
expected_answer: No. API access starts at Starter.

question: What is the maximum number of seats on Enterprise?
expected_answer: The docs do not define an Enterprise plan; do not invent a seat limit.

question: How long can I download a generated CSV file?
expected_answer: The export download link is available for 24 hours.
